gaps.lead: Pay claims must be submitted before the end of the month.
gaps.sentence: You have ___ your pay claims before the end of the month.
gaps.explanation: 'Must be submitted' becomes 'you have to put in your claims'.

gaps.lead: The tickets are certain to be expensive this year.
gaps.explanation: be bound to do = be certain to do.

gaps.lead: She started working here five years ago.
gaps.explanation: 'Started five years ago' → present perfect with 'for'.

gaps.lead: People say the castle is haunted.
gaps.explanation: People say X is… → X is said to be…
last did X in (year) = haven't done X since (year).

gaps.lead: She left early because she didn't want to miss the train.
gaps.explanation: so as not to / in order not to + infinitive.
